description: Election Commission - Mrs. A. F. Fajiha of the Eravur Urban Council has vacated his office of member of that Urban Council - Mr. M. Rebupasam of the Eravur Urban Council has vacated his office of member of that U/C
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that two members of the Eravur Urban Council have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected local government officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about candidate status and vacancies.
